_note: Default Flow layouts by project type: the four columns a feature is made of - Screens -> Actions -> Logic -> Data - matched by the layer lens the scan writes, so every project type shares them; only the edges drawn differ. The scan copies the matching one into <project>/.cockpit/plugins/architecture.layout.json; an unedited copy follows the type, an edited one is never touched. Columns match by kind (a node's kind tag), nodeKind, tag ('ns:value'), role (source | hub | sink | isolated) or folder (path prefix); a node lands in the first column it matches.

columns.title: Screens
columns.help: what a person sees - pages, components, styles

columns.title: Actions
columns.help: what a screen can ask for - the routes, each the single door into a feature

columns.title: Logic
columns.help: the code that does the work - the only layer that reads and writes

columns.title: Data
columns.help: the tables, and the migrations that define them - one owner each
